meta.title: Auction-team members cannot open technical or price rounds, but can open shared ones only if allowed
gaps: The vocabulary has no setup recipe for an auction team, user U, shared-round access lists, or a user outside the buyer workspace.
There is no operation for opening technical, pricing, or auction rounds; open_bid opens a bid, not a round.
The case's role-specific refusal and allowance behavior cannot be expressed without an endpoint or request path.
